definition-dropped.answer: Read §2002:4 'report': 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 drops the definition and identifies a report by its RD and the REPORT clause (§2023:13.18.46.1). Same entity in both, so the rule governs the same report description entries and report groups in 2002; scope and evidence unchanged. The rule's 'type' is 'the type of report group' (the report-group TYPE clause, §2002:13.16.55 format 2), not the type that §2002:4 defines for a type declaration ('A template that contains all the characteristics of a data item and its subordinates', the same words as §2023:8.5.3.1); the dropped definition cannot change which programs the rule governs.

pending-clause.answer: Invoked only by the word 'type'. §2002:8.5.3 (TYPEDEF types), §2002:8.5.4 (zero-length items) and §2002:14.5.8 (alignment of data in a receiving item) do not bear on NEXT GROUP or LINE-COUNTER; the rule does not rest on their 2002 text, and the evidence already shown at --std 2002 stands.
